run_simulation: run a torax transport simulation with a Python config file and optional flags like --log_progress
run_simulation_interactive: run a torax simulation in interactive mode to repeatedly run, modify config, and plot results
run_simulation_with_profiler: run a torax simulation with JAX profiler enabled to capture performance traces
run_simulation_with_reference: run a torax simulation and compare the output against a reference run
run_simulation_with_plotting: run a torax simulation and plot previous runs or compare against a reference run
